assumptions: Option codes follow the order printed in the questionnaire.
Numeric-entry and rating tags in the document are treated as range validation rules.

sourceAnchor.quote: S1. Which of the following best describes your primary professional role?

items.requirement: S1 asks which option best describes the respondent's primary professional role.
items.stimulus: Open the survey at the entry URL and read the first screener question.
items.expectedObservable: S1 is shown as a single-select question with the four documented role options.

sourceAnchor.quote: S2. How many years have you been in clinical practice?

items.requirement: S2 asks how many years the respondent has been in clinical practice.
items.stimulus: Answer S1 and advance to the next screener question.
items.expectedObservable: S2 is shown with a numeric entry field.

sourceAnchor.quote: [INSTRUCTION: Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.]

items.requirement: S2 displays the instruction 'Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.'
items.stimulus: Read the instruction line rendered with S2.
items.expectedObservable: The instruction text 'Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.' appears with S2.

items.requirement: S2 must accept only whole numbers between 0 and 50.
items.stimulus: Enter 99 at S2 and try to advance.
items.expectedObservable: The out-of-range value is rejected and the survey stays on S2.

sourceAnchor.quote: Q1. How many patients with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis do you personally manage in a typical month?

items.requirement: Q1 asks how many moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis patients the respondent manages in a typical month.
items.stimulus: Advance past the screener and read the first main question.
items.expectedObservable: Q1 is shown with a numeric entry field.

sourceAnchor.quote: [INSTRUCTION: Enter a whole number between 0 and 500.]

items.requirement: Q1 displays the instruction 'Enter a whole number between 0 and 500.'
items.stimulus: Read the instruction line rendered with Q1.
items.expectedObservable: The instruction text 'Enter a whole number between 0 and 500.' appears with Q1.

items.requirement: Q1 must accept only whole numbers between 0 and 500.
items.stimulus: Enter 900 at Q1 and try to advance.
items.expectedObservable: The out-of-range value is rejected and the survey stays on Q1.

sourceAnchor.quote: Q2. Do you currently prescribe biologic therapies for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?

items.requirement: Q2 asks whether the respondent currently prescribes biologic therapies for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.
items.expectedObservable: Q2 is shown as a Yes/No single-select question.

items.requirement: If Q2 is answered No, the respondent skips ahead to Q5.
items.stimulus: Answer No at Q2 and advance.
items.expectedObservable: The next screen after Q2 is Q5; Q3 and Q4 are never shown.

items.requirement: When Q2 is answered Yes the survey continues to Q3.
items.stimulus: Answer Yes at Q2 and advance.
items.expectedObservable: The next screen after Q2 is Q3.

sourceAnchor.quote: Q3. Which of the following biologic therapies do you currently prescribe for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?

items.requirement: Q3 asks which biologic therapies the respondent currently prescribes for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.
items.stimulus: Answer Yes at Q2 and advance to the brand list.
items.expectedObservable: Q3 is shown as a multi-select with five brands: SKYRIZI, TREMFYA, COSENTYX, TALTZ and BIMZELX.

items.requirement: Q3 displays the instruction 'Select all that apply.'
items.stimulus: Read the instruction line rendered with Q3.
items.expectedObservable: The instruction text 'Select all that apply.' appears with Q3.

sourceAnchor.quote: Q4. Overall, how satisfied are you with the biologic therapies you currently prescribe for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?

items.requirement: Q4 asks how satisfied the respondent is overall with the biologic therapies they currently prescribe for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.
items.expectedObservable: Q4 is shown as a five-point satisfaction scale.

sourceAnchor.quote: Q5. What is the single biggest barrier to biologic use in your moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis patients?

items.requirement: Q5 asks for the single biggest barrier to biologic use among the respondent's moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis patients.
items.stimulus: Reach Q5 on either route and read the question.
items.expectedObservable: Q5 is shown as a single-select list of five barriers.

sourceAnchor.quote: Q6. How likely are you to recommend biologic therapy to a colleague treating moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?

items.requirement: Q6 asks how likely the respondent is to recommend biologic therapy to a colleague treating moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.
items.stimulus: Answer Q5 and advance to the final question.
items.expectedObservable: Q6 is shown as an 0-10 rating scale.

sourceAnchor.quote: [INSTRUCTION: 0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely]

items.requirement: Q6 displays the scale instruction '0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely'.
items.stimulus: Read the instruction line rendered with Q6.
items.expectedObservable: The scale anchors '0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely' appear with Q6.

items.requirement: Q6 must accept only whole numbers between 0 and 10.
items.stimulus: Enter 11 at Q6 and try to submit.
items.expectedObservable: The out-of-range value is rejected and the survey stays on Q6.

sourceAnchor.quote: Programming: one question per screen. Respondents may not navigate backwards. All questions require an answer before continuing.

items.requirement: The survey ends on the normal completion screen.
items.stimulus: Answer every question on a documented route and submit the last one.
items.expectedObservable: The completion screen 'Thank you for completing the survey.' is shown.

findings.summary: Q2=No routes to Q6 instead of Q5
findings.expected: Answering No at Q2 should take the respondent to Q5, the barriers question.
findings.observed: After answering No at Q2 the survey jumped straight to Q6, so Q5 was never shown.

findings.summary: BIMZELX is missing from the Q3 brand list
findings.expected: Q3 should offer BIMZELX as the fifth brand option.
findings.observed: Q3 rendered only four brands (SKYRIZI, TREMFYA, COSENTYX, TALTZ); BIMZELX is absent.

findings.summary: Q3 is missing the 'Select all that apply.' instruction
findings.expected: Q3 should display the instruction 'Select all that apply.'
findings.observed: No 'Select all that apply.' instruction is shown above the Q3 options.
